notes: Patch release: two wire fixes found while bringing the D2 usage ledger up against the live Cloudflare edge. The reporter now sends a named product User-Agent — Cloudflare's browser-signature rule answers 1010/403 to Python-urllib's default signature, so without it no install could ever deliver a report to the production endpoint (core grew one leg to pin the header, 2081/2081). The deploy script's D1 ensure now parses the real CF API shapes (databases are name/uuid, not KV's title/id) and binds with the Pages entry key id — with database_id the binding PATCH is rejected and the ledger endpoints stay honestly pending. Verified live: /api/stats and /api/visits 200 on both domains, a canary report round-trips through validation, upsert and aggregate exclusion, and the models chart flips to its live state.
